headline: Harness Engineering for Auditable Enterprise LLM Agents
reasoning: This paper presents a novel and significant approach to making enterprise LLM applications auditable and reliable, moving beyond prompt engineering to 'harness engineering.' It addresses a critical pain point for businesses adopting LLMs, offering a technically credible solution from a research paper. The focus on auditable, traceable, and robust LLM agents is highly relevant to the practical deployment of AI.
summary: Researchers propose a 'harness engineering' method to transform LLM prototypes into auditable enterprise applications, ensuring source boundaries, entity routing, and answer contracts through code-owned validation rather than just prompting.

source_articles.title: From Prompts to Contracts: Harness Engineering for Auditable Enterprise LLM Agents
